subject: learning/forgejo-review-publication-and-scoped-evidence
statement: Forgejo implementation reviews use the existing durable publication and recovery protocol with qualified proposal/receipt identities. Review obligations, process records, and publication evidence each accept a configured Git ref, and coordinator, publication adapter, and recovery verification all select those same refs.
intent: Preserve review authenticity and restart behavior while allowing independent feature runs to reuse one remote repository safely.
rationale: A proposal reference must preserve its provider, server port, and base path, and a receipt must identify the repository and native comment. Reusing default review evidence refs during a temporary shared-repository test would write into unrelated durable review state; creating only some alternate refs is insufficient because repair can still consult the defaults. All three evidence stores therefore need scoped configuration propagated through execution, exact-read publication, and repair.
fit_criterion: Native Forgejo publication retains the same durable fence as GitHub; exact reads reject foreign or malformed receipts and preserve permission/trust checks; the configured-ref regression seeds the shared defaults, completes and repairs a review through alternate refs, and proves all seeded defaults remain unchanged.
